dedupe_keys.name: monthly global cement and clinker production data robbie andrew cicero

description: This dataset collates reported monthly cement and clinker production from national sources and the discontinued UN Monthly Bulletin of Statistics into machine-readable CSV and JSON. The Zenodo record says it holds 175 production time series, 46 of them from the UN bulletin, with Chinese provincial clinker production for 2013 to 2020 and some lime production; 70 series for 24 countries are linked to live sources, the earliest data start in 1982 (Taiwan), and the October 2025 release runs to August 2025. Clinker trade data from UN Comtrade sit in separate files. It is maintained by Robbie Andrew of the CICERO Center for International Climate Research under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download, with every source listed in a JSON metadata file. Coverage is global but patchy. Caveats: series are incomplete, values are actual production not capacity, nothing is interpolated, and the author asks to be contacted about co-authorship when used in research. For simulation it gives monthly national cement output to track construction material supply, demand shocks and recovery after disasters or energy crises. Related catalogue records include the annual global cement production data and the GCP-CEM cement process emissions dataset.
